title: Long-Tailed Question Answering in an Open World

layout.note: Left, about 60% of the width: a dashed inset on top (two examples into LM g, two outputs), under it two tinted regions stacked, Knowledge Mining (green, top) and Knowledge Sharing (yellow, bottom), whose outputs meet in a prompt bar that runs right into QA model F and Output (a) at the edge. Right: a black-framed chat panel with three bubbles reading top-down.

lesson: Pair the abstract framework with a framed trace of one question drawn as a chat, and reuse the chip colours of the framework inside the prompt bubble so the two views map onto each other; title and tint each contribution as its own region.
